description: Changes the workspace filters. These are excludedTerms (`*` at either end is a wildcard), excludedAuthors (links, handles or names), excludedRepos (owner/name or a github.com link), subreddits.only (allowed subreddits, and when set, excluded is ignored) and subreddits.excluded. Every list is optional. A list you leave out stays as it is, and an empty list clears it. New mentions follow the change within a minute.

inputSchema.description: Fields you leave out stay as they are. An empty list clears a field.

excludedAuthors.description: Sets a new list. An empty list clears it.

excludedRepos.description: Sets a new list. An empty list clears it.

excludedTerms.description: Sets a new list. An empty list clears it.

subreddits.description: Applies to Reddit only. A list you leave out stays as it is.

excluded.description: Sets a new list of blocked subreddits. An empty list clears it.

only.description: Sets a new list of allowed subreddits. An empty list clears it.
